items.exampleEn: The country has had a trade deficit for three years.
items.exampleZh: 這個國家已經連續三年貿易赤字。

items.exampleEn: A hundred years ago, only wealthy families could afford cars.
items.exampleZh: 一百年前，只有富裕的家庭買得起車。

items.exampleEn: They took out a mortgage to buy their first apartment.
items.exampleZh: 他們申請了房貸，買下第一間公寓。

items.exampleEn: Running the cafe was hard, but financially it was a success.
items.exampleZh: 經營咖啡店很辛苦，但在財務上是成功的。

items.exampleEn: She left a lucrative job at a bank to become a painter.
items.exampleZh: 她辭掉銀行裡收入豐厚的工作，去當畫家。

items.exampleEn: The farm became deeply indebted after two bad harvests.
items.exampleZh: 那座農場在兩次歉收之後負債累累。

items.exampleEn: My frugal roommate cuts his own hair to save money.
items.exampleZh: 我那位節儉的室友自己剪頭髮來省錢。

items.exampleEn: The stock market was closed for the holiday.

items.sentenceEn: Paying the mortgage takes almost half of my salary.
items.sentenceZh: 付房貸幾乎用掉我一半的薪水。

items.audioEn: The city has a budget deficit this year, so it will delay building the new swimming pool.
items.audioZh: 市政府今年預算赤字，所以會延後興建新游泳池。
items.questionZh: 市政府因為赤字要怎麼做？
options: Close two public libraries this year
Build the pool later than planned

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother was very frugal and never threw away old clothes.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶非常節儉，從來不丟舊衣服。

items.sentenceEn: I am deeply indebted to my teacher for her support.
items.sentenceZh: 我非常感激老師對我的支持。

items.stemEn: Selling coffee near the train station turned out to be very ____; the shop earned more than expected.
items.stemZh: 在火車站附近賣咖啡結果非常賺錢；那家店賺得比預期還多。

items.stemEn: After she got a better job, she became ____ independent.
items.stemZh: 她找到更好的工作後，經濟上就獨立了。

items.passageEn: My uncle and my aunt both grew up poor, but they live very different lives. My uncle, a successful entrepreneur, became wealthy in his thirties. He started a lucrative online business, and later he sold part of the company on the stock market. My aunt is a nurse and is still very frugal. She paid off her mortgage early by cooking at home and riding a bike to work. A few years ago, my uncle's company had a big deficit, and he was heavily indebted for a while. My aunt lent him some money, and he paid her back within a year. Today, they both say they are financially comfortable.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔和阿姨都在窮困中長大，但他們過著很不一樣的生活。我叔叔是一位成功的創業家，三十幾歲就變得很富有。他開了一個很賺錢的網路事業，後來把公司的一部分在股市賣出。我阿姨是一位護理師，至今仍然非常節儉。她靠著在家煮飯、騎腳踏車上班，提早還清了房貸。幾年前，叔叔的公司出現大筆赤字，他有一段時間負債很重。阿姨借了他一些錢，他在一年內就還給她了。如今，他們兩人都說自己在經濟上過得很寬裕。

questions.questionZh: 阿姨怎麼提早還清房貸？
options: 向叔叔借一大筆錢來還清
把原本的房子賣掉換小的

questions.questionZh: 叔叔的公司出現赤字時發生了什麼？
options: 他把公司賣給了一家大企業
他搬去和阿姨一起住了一年

items.promptZh: 我爺爺每天早上都看股市新聞。
referenceEn: My grandfather watches the stock market news every morning.
Every morning, my grandfather reads news about the stock market.
rubricZh: 「股市」可寫，例如 the stock market 等
「看新聞」可寫，例如 watches the news、reads the news 等
說習慣，時態合理（例如 watches、reads 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 wealthy 造一個句子，說說一個有錢的人或地區有什麼特色。
referenceEn: The wealthy area near the river has many large houses.
My wealthy neighbor still drives a very old car.
rubricZh: wealthy 可放在名詞前或 be 動詞後（例如 a wealthy family、is wealthy 等）
時態配合內容（例如 has、drives 等）
